definitions: An American media company that provides news and information with a stated goal of exposing people to multiple perspectives across the political spectrum.
A website and mobile application operated by the company AllSides, known for its media bias ratings and balanced news feeds.
examples: Many people use AllSides to understand different viewpoints.
The AllSides platform categorizes news sources by their political leanings.
I checked AllSides for a balanced view on the recent election.
